exceptions: fine or penalty ₹1.51 lakh: BSE LIMITED (The Company had received Notice from BSE Limited via email on 21st November, 2024 imposing a fine of Rs. 1,51,040/- in r)

penalties.details: The Company had received Notice from BSE Limited via email on 21st November, 2024 imposing a fine of Rs. 1,51,040/- in relation to non-compliance with Regulation 17(1A) of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 pertaining to appointment of Non-Executive Director who has attained the age of 75 years. The Company had filed a waiver application against the fine imposed on 2nd December, 2024. However, BSE Limited rejected the said application vide its email dated 26th February, 2026 and requested to pay the aforesaid fine amount within 10 days from the date of intimation. Accordingly, the Company paid the fine on 6th March, 2026.
